title: A Mosquito Can Triple Its Weight in One Bite and Still Fly

scenes.text: One mosquito bite can triple its body weight.
It drinks until its belly swells into a red balloon.
Imagine you ate three of yourself and then went flying.
Scientists filmed it with high speed cameras.
After feeding, it flaps its wings wider and faster to stay in the air.
Triple the weight, and it still hovers away. Now watch it again.

description:
A mosquito can gain about triple its body weight in a single blood meal.
High speed cameras showed it changes how it flaps its wings to stay airborne with the extra load.
Would you rather fight one mosquito or a hundred flies?
first_comment: What is the biggest thing you have ever swatted?
